data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **Bitwarden Teams** as the best overall choice.

It's secure, affordable, straightforward to administer, and has the features that actually matter when multiple people need access to company passwords.

However, there are three particularly good options depending on your priorities.

## My top 3 recommendations

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best overall)

# \$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Shared password collections
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Open-source software
- Directory synchronisation and SCIM
- Good value for growing teams
  
  [Official pricing](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. 1Password**

(Best user experience)

- Excellent, polished interface
- Very good shared vault management
- Granular access permissions
- Great for non-technical employees
- Strong business administration features

Ideal if ease of use and employee adoption matter more than price.

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Proton Pass**

(Best privacy-focused option)

- End-to-end encrypted password storage
- Shared vaults and secure sharing
- Open-source applications
- Dark web monitoring
- Business administration features

Particularly attractive if privacy is a major consideration.

[Official pricing](https://proton.me/business/pass/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Quick comparison

| Feature | Bitwarden | 1Password | Proton Pass |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Shared passwords | Excellent | Excellent | Excellent |
| Admin controls | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Audit logs | Yes | Yes | Higher tier |
| Open source | Yes | No | Yes |
| Ease of use | Very good | Excellent | Very good |
| Budget friendly | Excellent | Moderate | Excellent |


Based on published business features and pricing. [bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[proton.me](https://proton.me/business/pass/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bravotech.org](https://www.bravotech.org/best-password-managers-small-teams/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

- **2–5 people\:** Bitwarden Teams.
- **5–15 people\:** Bitwarden Teams or 1Password.
- **15–30 people\:** Bitwarden or 1Password Business, depending on administration needs.
- **Privacy-focused business\:** Proton Pass.

One important point: whichever you choose, make sure you can share passwords through team vaults rather than sending credentials through email, Slack or WhatsApp. Also enable mandatory MFA and ensure departing employees lose access immediately.

## A question to narrow it down

How many people are in your team?

That will help me recommend the right plan and avoid paying for enterprise features you don't need.
